name: Banana Muffins
instructions: Leave {salted-butter:full} and {egg:full} out on counter to get to room temperature.
Place {foil-cupcake-liner:full} on {sheet-pan:full}. Place a {paper-cupcake-liner} in every {foil-cupcake-liner}.
Measure {ap-flour:full}. Level off the tablespoons of flour with a {knife} before removing. Pour the flour in {large-bowl}
Whisk flour and baking soda together until combined.

Cut butter into smaller chunks and place in {small-bowl}. Cover and heat in microwave, stirring every 15 seconds. Once full melted, pour in {mixing-bowl}, using a {silicone-spatula} to get all the butter.
Whisk sugar and butter for ~3 minutes or until light and airy
Crack {egg:full} into {small-bowl}. Whisk with {fork} and pour into {mixing-bowl}.
While whisking {mixing-bowl}, incrementally add dry ingredients. Be careful not to overmix.
Peel {banana:full} and place in {medium-bowl}. Mash with masher.
Pour bananas into {mixing-bowl}, using a {silicone-spatula} to get all the banana pieces.
Fold bananas into batter using the {silicone-spatula}.
Fill each cupcake liner 2/3 full with batter.
Bake muffins in the {oven} until tops are golden brown or a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean (~25-30 minutes).
Allow muffins to cool on the {sheet-pan} for 10 minutes before serving.
